verdict.rationale: Justworks documents a Xero integration where users connect their Xero account, map pay types to Chart of Accounts, override mappings by department/office/employee, and choose manual or automatic (day-after-processing) sync of invoices/journal entries. This covers the core of the story for Xero specifically. Missing for 10: explicit QuickBooks integration documentation (only Xero is evidenced), and no independent/hands-on corroboration of sync reliability.
